Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that Greyhound Canada ceased operations in 2018 and concluded there were no Greyhound departures from Toronto, shifting focus to current status instead of identifying the canonical departure location. This conflated the 2018 western-route cuts with the full shutdown (2021) and derailed the path to the expected answer: Toronto Coach Terminal.
